evidence_requirements.description: The explanation uses only the declared robot-visible packet; delivered observations do not prove Nav2 internal consumption.
The recorded navigation action reported succeeded.
The recorded navigation action reported aborted.
The recorded navigation action reported canceled.
An observed violation establishes failure of the specified fixed docking dwell.
All required conditions are supported at observed samples across the declared fixed dwell.
Completion of the specified fixed docking dwell is unestablished by available evidence.
The declared dwell starts at the first post-result observation, independently of action receipt time.
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured position error and signed position margin.
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured heading error.
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured translational speed.
The signed change in observed radial position error from the declared reference observation to the final selected dwell sample is as follows.
An observed position violation falsifies the corresponding dwell requirement. Values are measured at the witness sample, not an inferred continuous-time crossing.
The position requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available.
The available evidence does not establish whether the position requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
An observed heading violation falsifies the corresponding dwell requirement. Values are measured at the witness sample, not an inferred continuous-time crossing.
The heading requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available.
The available evidence does not establish whether the heading requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
An observed speed violation falsifies the corresponding dwell requirement. Values are measured at the witness sample, not an inferred continuous-time crossing.
The speed requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available.
The available evidence does not establish whether the speed requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
An observed yaw rate violation falsifies the corresponding dwell requirement. Values are measured at the witness sample, not an inferred continuous-time crossing.
The yaw rate requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available.
The available evidence does not establish whether the yaw rate requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
An observed hull violation falsifies the corresponding dwell requirement. Values are measured at the witness sample, not an inferred continuous-time crossing.
The hull requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available.
The available evidence does not establish whether the hull requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
Prohibited hull contact was observed within the declared dwell; this falsifies the contact requirement.
An aligned complete prohibited-contact event stream covering the declared dwell establishes contact absence under its explicit capture guarantee.
The task requires no prohibited hull contact during the dwell; available contact evidence does not establish whether this requirement held.
Independent evidence establishes a specific physical cause.
An intersample bound establishes continuous-time compliance.
The navigation fixture reported timeout.
The fixture timeout does not establish a terminal ROS action result, cancellation, or docking failure.
The visible configuration records the XY goal tolerance; this observation does not establish internal consumption or why the boat stopped.
The visible configuration records the yaw goal tolerance; this observation does not establish internal consumption or why the boat stopped.
The visible configuration records the translational stopped-velocity tolerance; this observation does not establish internal consumption or why the boat stopped.
The visible configuration records the rotational stopped-velocity tolerance; this observation does not establish internal consumption or why the boat stopped.
The separate public docking task requires the fixed dwell and position, heading, speed, and yaw-rate limits shown here; configured navigation tolerances do not replace these requirements.
The recorded client receipt time uses the fixture-monotonic wall clock; it is not the ROS-header sample clock or the first post-result sample that anchors the fixed dwell.

non_entailments.rationale: These observations do not identify the physical cause of motion; waves, current, wind and actuation remain unresolved.
Samples do not establish continuous-time compliance between observations; an observed violation is sufficient to falsify the dwell.
